query: Find the first name and country code of the oldest player.

artifact.sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN winner_age >= loser_age OR loser_age IS NULL THEN SUBSTR(winner_name, 1, INSTR(winner_name || ' ', ' ') - 1)
    ELSE SUBSTR(loser_name, 1, INSTR(loser_name || ' ', ' ') - 1)
  END AS first_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN winner_age >= loser_age OR loser_age IS NULL THEN winner_ioc
    ELSE loser_ioc
  END AS country_code
FROM register
WHERE CASE 
    WHEN winner_age >= loser_age OR loser_age IS NULL THEN winner_age
    ELSE loser_age
  END = (
    SELECT MAX(age) FROM (
      SELECT winner_age AS age FROM register WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL
      SELECT loser_age AS age FROM register WHERE loser_age IS NOT NULL
    )
  )
LIMIT 1

    SUBSTR(winner_name, 1, INSTR(winner_name || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS first_name,
    winner_ioc AS country_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tourney_id) AS tour_count
FROM (
    SELECT winner_name, winner_ioc, tourney_id FROM register
    UNION ALL
    SELECT loser_name, loser_ioc, tourney_id FROM register
)
GROUP BY winner_name, winner_ioc
ORDER BY tour_count DESC
LIMIT 1
